map.眼表荧光素染色评分器 使用指南: Ocular surface fluorescein staining scorer user guide
map.基于NEI(美国国立眼科研究所)分区评分法。角膜分5区、鼻/颞侧结膜各分3区，每: Based on the NEI (US National Eye Institute) zoning scoring method. Cornea is divided into 5 zones, nasal/temporal conjunctiva each into 3 zones, each zone 0-3 points. Cornea and conjunctiva are scored separately.
map.按 0–3 分对 5 个角膜区分区评分，总分 0–15。: Score 5 corneal zones by 0-3 points each, total 0-15.
map.干眼、角膜上皮缺损、角膜缘炎评估。: Dry eye, corneal epithelial defect, limbal inflammation assessment.
map.：角膜总分 = 2+1 = 3/15，属轻度点状染色；结膜另计 0–18 分。: : corneal total = 2+1 = 3/15, mild punctate staining; conjunctiva counted separately 0-18.
map.：总分 15/15 为弥漫重度染色，提示广泛上皮损伤。: : total 15/15 is diffuse severe staining, indicating widespread epithelial damage.
map.0 无染色、1 散在点、2 融合斑片、3 大片缺如，按染色范围与密度。: 0 no staining, 1 scattered dots, 2 confluent patches, 3 large absence, graded by staining extent and density.
map.角膜与结膜分开评？: Are cornea and conjunctiva scored separately?
map.是，角膜 0–15、结膜另有 0–18 分区，分别反映不同部位损伤。: Yes, cornea 0-15, conjunctiva additionally 0-18 zones, reflecting damage at different sites respectively.
